thread:
maya: quick design check — Security > Keys page. i moved the ‘Key owner’ hint into the right column in the mock to avoid wrapping, but it feels visually disconnected from the key label. thinking about accessibility and visual weight. rohit: can you paste the mock? curious about spacing and whether the hint will read before the key name for screen readers. maya: screenshot: https://img.redwood/example-keys-hint.png maya: current idea: - Key name (bold) - small grey hint pill: \"Owned by Acme Corp (BYOK)\" - KMS badge on the right rohit: two quick concerns: 1) for keyboard/sr order we should keep the hint immediately after the key name in the DOM, even if visually it sits to the right. use CSS order for layout, not DOM reorder. 2) the pill contrast is borderline — 3:1 visible but fails for small text at 12px. suggest 4.5:1 for readability. olivia: +1 on DOM order. also the hint needs an aria-describedby link so screen readers pick it up as context for the key name. sample: ```
payment-key Owned by Acme Corp — BYOK
``` rohit: nice. also consider truncation: long tenant names will push layout. maybe we make the hint collapsible behind a chevron for >2 lines, but keep the icon badge visible. maya: i worry collapsible adds friction for the common case (short names). maybe show full pill on desktop, collapse to tooltip on mobile. aiden: for audit log copy, separate note — when a key is rotated we show: \"Key rotated by — previous versions retained 30 days\". suggestion: remove ambiguous \"retained\" phrasing. say: \"Previous key versions will remain usable for 30 days for decryption.\" olivia: yes that wording is clearer for assistive tech. also add aria-live region for the rotation toast so screen readers announce it: ```
Key rotated by Maya — previous versions available for 30 days.
``` maya: product-bot ran Lighthouse a11y on the mock: contrast 0.88 (fail), landmark order warning. product-bot: Lighthouse summary: contrast issues on .hint (AA small fail), document landmarks out of order when hint moved with CSS order. Please fix DOM ordering for landmarks. rohit: ok action items: - keep DOM order: key name then hint, use CSS for visuals (rohit) - bump hint color to 4.5:1 (design) - add aria-describedby between name and hint (eng) - adjust rotation copy to explicit decryption window (content) - ensure toast has aria-live polite (eng) maya: timeline? can we include in this sprint (end of week) for the console compliance view updates? i'm happy to own design changes. rohit: i'll schedule a quick pairing tomorrow to wire the aria-describedby and do a dev review. :thumbsup: aiden: will update audit log copy and send through legal quick glance. olivia: i'll do a quick screen reader pass once we have the DOM changes. maya: awesome — thanks everyone :sparkles:
notes: thread focuses on placement and accessibility of key ownership hints, contrast, DOM ordering vs visual order, aria-describedby and aria-live for toasts, and clearer audit log copy wording. short action list assigned. includes a Lighthouse bot result.
